summary: 1937 CCC Wildland #2 Tower, moved about 1964 to the Bald Knob site in Land Between the Lakes; USFS-owned, NHLR-registered 2009. Public access not stated.

facts.design: 80-foot Aermotor tower with 7 by 7 foot metal cab (LS-40 model per FFLOS)

events.note: Built by the Civilian Conservation Corps as the Wildland #2 Tower for the Kentucky Division of Forestry, at its original site.
Moved from the original site to the current site along US 68/KY 80. The NHLR 'Built' field also reads 1964.
Registered November 3, 2009 as US 831, KY 7; nominated by Trenton C. Girard.
Original site registered on Former Fire Lookout Sites as Wildland #2 Tower Site, US 1744, KY 5.

corrections.current: 1964 built ('Built' field on NHLR detail page)
corrections.proposed: 1937 built by the CCC; 1964 relocated to the current site
corrections.why: The NHLR description, the Forest Lookouts page and the FFLOS record all date the build to 1937 and the move to about 1964.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR 'Built' field reads 1964. Its own description, the Forest Lookouts page and the FFLOS record give 1937 as the build year and 1964 as the move to the current site.

NHLR gives the current owner as the U.S. Forest Service. The FFLOS record for the original site lists the Kentucky Division of Forestry as administrator. These describe different sites and periods, so the record uses the current owner.

notes_for_editor: Build and move history is consistent across three sources once the NHLR Built field is read as the move year. Public access, climbing status and staffing are not stated in any source read, so visit and access fields are left out. The LS-40 model name comes only from the FFLOS page. Two WebSearch calls used; a Facebook aerial video and an onX trail page turned up but were not used.
